title: Cardiovascular disease causes proinflammatory microvascular changes in the human right atrium
authors: Linna-Kuosmanen S; Schmauch E; Galani K; Ojanen J; Boix CA; Örd T; Toropainen A; Singha PK; Moreau PR; Harju K; Blazeski A; Segerstolpe Å; Lahtinen V; Hou L; Kang K; Meibalan E; Agudelo LZ; Kokki H; Halonen J; Jalkanen J; Gunn J; MacRae CA; Hollmén M; Hartikainen J; Kaikkonen MU; García-Cardeña G; Tavi P; Kiviniemi T; Kellis M
one_liner_zh: 该文利用单核RNA-seq和空间转录组研究右心房组织中的炎症微血管变化，纯转录组分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract:
Ischemic heart disease is globally the leading cause of death. It plays a central role in the electrical and structural remodeling of the right atrium, predisposing to arrhythmias, heart failure, and sudden death. Here, we provide the first dissection of the gene expression changes in the live right atrial tissue, using single-nuclei RNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics. We investigate matched samples of the tissue and pericardial fluid and reveal substantial differences in disease- associated gene expression in all cell types, leading to inflammatory microvascular dysfunction and changes in the tissue composition. Our study demonstrates the importance of creating high- resolution cellular maps and partitioning disease signals beyond epicardial coronary arteries and ischemic left ventricle to identify candidate mechanisms leading to more severe types of human cardiovascular disease.

One-Sentence Summary

Single-cell dissection of ex vivo heart biopsies and pericardial fluid in ischemic heart disease and heart failure
abstract_zh:
缺血性心脏病是全球首要死因。它在右心房的电学和结构重塑中发挥核心作用，易导致心律失常、心力衰竭和猝死。在此，我们利用单核RNA测序 (single-nuclei RNA-seq) 和空间转录组学 (spatial transcriptomics)，首次对活体右心房组织中的基因表达变化进行了解剖分析。我们研究了组织与心包液的匹配样本，并揭示了所有细胞类型中疾病相关基因表达的显著差异，导致炎症性微血管功能障碍及组织组成的变化。我们的研究强调了创建高分辨率细胞图谱并将疾病信号从心外膜冠状动脉和缺血性左心室中分离出来的重要性，以识别导致更严重类型人类心血管疾病的候选机制。

一句话摘要

对缺血性心脏病和心力衰竭中离体心脏活检及心包液的单细胞解剖分析
